'''Quara''' were an [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] [[Subspecies/Legends|subspecies]] hailing from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ando/Legends|Ando]]. Like the [[Ualaq/Legends|Ualaq]] subspecies, the Quara evolved from the baseline [[Aquala/Legends|Aquala]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. Quara only made up about ten percent of the Aqualish population, despite their five-fingered hands making them more comfortable with technology.
